tool_args.rationale: The pilot sink-gradient span is only 0.018. The open-branch probe varies the poorly identified regime and can distinguish the archived candidate mechanisms before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the siphon, Hill-inhibition, or barrier-modulated model directly
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows have nearly constant sink gradient, so sink dependence and branch terms are not reliably identifiable.
The observed signatures favor a static sink-gradient mechanism; trajectory data are a more expensive first discriminator.
It is irrelevant to the mechanism ambiguity.
